tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Curated places in Chelsea, optionally filtered by category, use-case tag or featured picks. Each result links to its https://knowchelsea.com/place/{slug} page. rankedUrl is https://knowchelsea.com/best/{category} for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop, and https://knowchelsea.com/best for e

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full record for one Chelsea place by slug: the guide's description and tip, address, coordinates, opening hours, website and the public /place URL. Use it for hours or an address, and for the coordinates of a station or landmark before calling nearby_places. openNow says whether the place is open at

tools.name: nearby_places
tools.description: Nearest curated Chelsea places to a WGS84 coordinate, with distance in metres. For places near a station or another place in the guide, take the coordinate from get_place (stations are places in category transport) and filter by category here.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Filter curated Chelsea places by category, sub-zone, tags, featured picks or text, ranked the same way as the published best-of lists. Every field carries its source; addresses, coordinates, hours and websites are not included, so call get_place for them. It cannot filter by opening hours: for what

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Side-by-side sourced records for 2 to 4 Chelsea places by slug, with the tags they share. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Published Chelsea themed guides (https://knowchelsea.com/guides/{slug}), with sourced titles, summaries and place counts.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One published Chelsea guide by slug: its introduction and its ranked places, every field sourced. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_place" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Full record for one Chelsea place by slug: the guide's description and tip, address, coordinates, opening hours, website and the public /place URL. Use it for h…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_place · Private data: get_place, compare_places · Public sink: compare_places.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_place · Private data: get_place, compare_places · Public sink: compare_places

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "get_place" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
